preview.label: UI preview
preview.notice: Sample contacts and sharing. Nothing is sent or shared.

contacts.title: Contacts
contacts.emptyHint: Add someone you trust to start sharing your plants.
contacts.removeHint: This also removes the plants shared between you and {{name}} in this preview.
contacts.noSharedByYou: You have not shared any plants with this contact.
contacts.noSharedWithYou: This contact has not shared any plants with you.
contacts.idHint: This sample ID is for trying the screens.
contacts.nameHint: Only you see this name. Their email and Flovers ID stay the same.
contacts.nameRequired: Enter a contact name (up to 80 characters).
contacts.deleteHint: Delete {{name}} from your contacts? This also ends plant sharing between you in this preview.

invite.title: Add contact
invite.label: Email or Flovers ID
invite.hint: Try an email address or a Flovers ID. No invitation will be sent from this preview.
invite.invalid: Enter a valid email address or Flovers ID.
invite.alreadyContact: This person is already in your contacts.
invite.alreadyPending: An invitation for this person is already pending.

plants.title: Shared plants
plants.emptyOutgoingBody: Choose plants and decide who can view them or complete their tasks.
plants.emptyIncomingBody: Plants shared by your contacts will appear here.
plants.removeBody: {{name}} will no longer have access to {{plant}}.
plants.leaveBody: {{plant}} will be removed from your shared plants.
plants.emptyAllBody: Share plants with a contact or ask someone to share theirs with you.

form.title: Share plants
form.singlePlantHint: Choose the plants and contacts to share them with.
form.noPlants: No plants available. Add a plant to start sharing.
form.noContacts: You can share plants once a contact invitation has been accepted.
form.permissionHint: View only unless task completion is enabled.
form.endDateHint: An optional end date for the selected contacts and plants.
form.multiPlantHint: Choose the plants and contacts to share them with.
form.mixedAccess: Has access to some selected plants. Select to add the rest.
form.mixedPermissions: Permissions differ between the selected plants.
form.endDatesVary: End dates differ between the selected plants.

toasts.plantLeft: Shared plant removed from this preview.
